project.name: LoopLedger
project.problem: Make agentic engineering homework evidence visible and auditable.

practices.evidence: AGENTS.md defines static rules, dynamic context, and maker/checker expectations.
practices.note: Static context lives in repo; dynamic context lives in docs/agentic-process-log.md.

practices.evidence: Implementation followed spec -> make -> verify -> check -> iterate.
practices.note: The CLI itself records these loops.

practices.evidence: Unit tests and a deterministic eval cover the report/audit behavior.
docs/checker-review.md records a separate review pass after implementation.
practices.note: Checker focuses on missing evidence and brittle behavior.

practices.evidence: docs/specification.md defines the scope and acceptance criteria before implementation.

cycles.goal: Create the evidence ledger data model and CLI.
cycles.checker: Separate Codex review pass using docs/checker-review.md

cycles.goal: Add deterministic eval for the sample ledger.
cycles.checker: Audit command plus manual report review

checks.name: unit tests
checks.evidence: Covers project creation, audit completeness, failed checks, Markdown report, and CLI paths.

checks.name: deterministic eval
checks.evidence: Validates the example ledger reports all required homework evidence.

decisions.title: Build a Python CLI instead of a web app
decisions.reason: The homework rewards process evidence. A CLI can expose context, loops, checks, and reports with less product surface area.
decisions.consequence: No frontend is needed; verification stays fast and deterministic.
